name: Buyer Representation
summary: Local guidance from first showing to keys in hand. Your offer is shaped by current comps and the real-time market activity behind them, so you know what a home is worth before you write one.

name: Seller Representation
summary: Custom property videos, community-first marketing, and staging, with pricing built on sold data plus the real-time market activity that only comes from being in the field every day.

name: Luxury Buyer & Seller Representation
summary: View properties, acreage, and estate homes sell to a smaller pool of buyers, which changes how they should be priced, marketed, and negotiated. Discreet representation with an off-market network behind it.

name: First-Time Homebuyer Representation
summary: Your first purchase, explained at your pace. You'll know what each document means, what every step costs, and what happens next, and no question is too small to ask.

name: Investment Representation
summary: Running the numbers before you commit: realistic rents, carrying costs, and what a property has to do to work as an investment rather than a hope.

name: Relocation Expertise
summary: Neighborhood-by-neighborhood orientation for buyers moving into the area from out of town, so the map makes sense before you ever get on a plane.
